office_does: The Coroner investigates all sudden, violent, suspicious and unusual deaths occurring in the county.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Incumbent Coroner Gary Warnock (Prefers Democratic Party), in office since 2007, is the only candidate on the ballot.

candidates.summary: Coroner since 2007 and a former deputy coroner and funeral director, running unopposed.
highlights: Cites state certification and national accreditation of the office in 2025 [S1]
Pledges a fiscally responsible office amid county budget pressures [S1]
